# Immersive booster capability

This capability is explicit-only. It requires an approved direction with `experience_mode: immersive` and rationale for every costly mechanism.

This restriction applies to the immersive booster, not to all 3D. A focused or standard landing may evaluate a contained 3D, shader, depth or spatial mechanism when it fits the subject and passes production constraints.

Treat preloaders, smooth scrolling, full-viewport heroes, split typography, cinematic entrances, grain, glass, large fluid type and scroll choreography as candidates—not defaults.

For each candidate answer:

- what project-specific idea it expresses;
- whether the essential journey works without it;
- accessibility and reduced-motion behavior;
- mobile and low-power behavior;
- asset/runtime cost;
- simpler alternative considered;
- prototype evidence and kill criterion.

Reject any mechanism activated only by the words “premium”, “Awwwards” or “Apple-style”. Record accepted mechanisms in `creative-direction.md` and `production-plan.md`.
